name: outage
description: Your phone charger is a power-grid sensor. Workspaces: core/*, web, tools/sim and tools/field. android/probe has its own installs.

scripts.probe:install: npm --prefix android/probe/worker ci && npm --prefix android/probe/analyze ci
scripts.probe:typecheck: npm --prefix android/probe/worker run typecheck && npm --prefix android/probe/analyze run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run probe:typecheck
